selectedOption.label: Select SWU-CAPI-000 for later Task Session admission

rationale: SWU-CAPI-000 is the Work Pack's narrowest structurally admissible predecessor.
It creates only a new isolated derived snapshot and evidence; it changes neither product code nor canonical Craft source.
It closes the WaveDB 0.15.9 snapshot gap before fresh-process verification or API construction can be claimed.
remainingBlockers: Invoke Refresh must synchronize selectedUnit and the exact allowed route into the Work Pack.
A separate Task Session must admit SWU-CAPI-000.
CAPI-B003 remains open until the immutable 0.15.9 snapshot passes its declared validation.
CAPI-B002 remains open for the later authentication/session and secret-provider units.
CAPI-B004 remains deferred outside the active L0 execution window.

assumptions: The selection applies only to the current immutable Work Pack frontier.
